scope: train descriptors; completed selected validation endpoints; no heldout

methodology.gap_and_history_population: canonical train targets excluding first event per entity
methodology.correlation: pooled residual Pearson correlation of adjacent log1p quantity pairs after separate within-entity means for predecessor and successor
methodology.validation_selection: same earliest strict minimum raw quantity RMSE checkpoint for every metric and stratum
methodology.validation_bins: frozen dataset-specific boundaries, right endpoint included, empty cells preserved
methodology.aggregation: event weighted within seed; arithmetic mean and sample SD across seeds42/52/62
methodology.anchor_rule: previously fixed strongest external mean validation RMSE model, unchanged by strata
methodology.mse_difference: mean over seeds of (SSE_MLP-SSE_anchor)/total_targets; not square of mean RMSE
